skills.description:
This skill should be used when WorkBuddy conversation history is incomplete or
needs maintenance: prompts/sessions not displaying (especially after upgrading to
5.9.x, where any session jsonl larger than 5MB only shows its tail), conversation
history truncated, only the last few turns visible, older messages missing,
broken parentId chains, corrupted jsonl lines, or needing to split oversized
sessions into fully-loadable segments, hide originals from the sidebar, or
restore them. It merges three tools into one program with a browser GUI:
(1) detect whether sessions were merged from another machine (multiple user_id
in the sessions table) and repair history first if so, then split oversized
sessions; (2) repair history (bad lines + relink parentId chains, zero data
loss); (3) split oversized sessions (>5MB, the 5.9.3 maxPageBytes limit) with
optional snapshot-stripping; (4) hide original sessions from the sidebar
(database flag only, files untouched, fully reversible); (5) restore hidden
originals; (6) generate a portable Windows launcher .bat at runtime
(wb_gen_launcher_bat.py) for environments where a .bat file cannot be
uploaded directly, e.g. the WorkBuddy open platform. Cross-platform paths
(Windows/Linux/macOS/container) driven by WB_HOME / WB_TOOL_DIR environment
variables.

Trigger keywords (Chinese): 会话不显示, 会话记录不显示, 提示词不显示, 提示词丢失,
提示词少了, 历史加载不全, 历史消息缺失, 聊天记录缺失, 只显示最近几条, 只显示十几条,
打开会话看不到以前内容, 升级后历史不见了, 升级 5.9.3 后会话变少, 滚动不到上面,
没有更早的消息, 翻页失效, 5MB 窗口, maxPageBytes, 拆分会话, 拆分超大会话,
超大会话, 拆分历史会话, 会话太大, jsonl 太大, 拆成多段, 分段会话, 大会话打不开,
修复历史会话, 修复历史提示词, parentId 断链, 消息链断裂, 消息树断裂, 坏行,
jsonl 损坏, JSON 解析失败, 会话串不起来, 隐藏原会话, 隐藏原件, 恢复原会话,
恢复隐藏的会话, 侧栏太乱, 会话太多想隐藏, deleted_at 标记, 其他机器会话合并,
跨机合并, 多个 user_id, 身份串了, 合并后会话不显示, 迁移后历史不全,
会话治理, 历史会话治理, 会话管理器, wb_session_manager,
wb_split_session, wb_fix_history, wb_hide_originals,
生成启动器, 生成 bat, bat 生成器, 启动器生成器, 可移植启动器, 双击启动,
bat 乱码, 批处理乱码, GBK 乱码, chcp 65001, 无法上传 bat, 上传不了 bat,
开放平台上传 bat, wb_gen_launcher_bat.

Trigger keywords (English): WorkBuddy history not showing, session history
missing, conversation history truncated, prompts missing, only latest messages
visible, older messages not loading, split oversized session, segment session
file, repair session history, fix broken message chain, corrupted jsonl,

generate launcher bat, bat generator, portable launcher, bat mojibake,
